notes.C01: Exact event logs beat pixel inference for own screen repros, but needs recorder/tool integration and covers only that slice
notes.C02: Pixel-inferred action scripts plus test compilation is a heavy, brittle detector stack; high build risk
notes.C03: Cheap one-image motion encoding from existing signals, but unproven whether VLMs read it
notes.C04: Directly closes the named audio gap with local, cheap text and strip output; strongest audio answer
notes.C05: Elegant A/V sync anchor for cause-effect, narrow applicability and needs audio tagging
notes.C06: Before/after pairs plus narrow look call cut images and address temporal questions concretely
notes.C07: Lazy question-driven sensing cuts upfront cost, but adds cache/router learning surface
notes.C08: Hook-triggered tiered sidecar delivers the zero-invocation daily-use goal; the main fix for the run-daily pain
notes.C09: Synthetic ground-truth bench is the cheap proof the brief asks for and doubles as self-test
notes.C10: Honest card with declared gaps and kill rule is sound discipline, mostly a format over other concepts
notes.C11: Paid API valve is opt-in and metered but adds egress and per-hour cost; weakest on running cost
notes.C12: Subagent viewers save main context but add token cost and double-watch overhead
notes.C13: Priming-bias guard is speculative, low value for daily use
notes.C14: Slow-change channel is a real detector gap, but a niche addition
notes.C15: Saliency budgeting is a plausible allocator but unproven and a thin add-on
